scoring_rules.json.scientific_requirements: Only the final propositions listed here are scored, once each, at their fixed weights. Each item receives full points for pass and zero for fail or need_review; review is not a pass. All items are required for whole-case success. Native inputs/outputs, molecular and state identity, numerical reference, convergence and claim-appropriate validation support the specific proposition and earn no independent points. Actual computation or reproducible analysis is required in both modes; copying disclosed PR targets does not count. AR chooses its method independently. PR reproduces its disclosed baseline or documents a scientifically justified substitute without relaxing numerical windows. Established equivalent explanations pass directly. Missing work, unsupported uncertainty, wrong identity/reference/units and numeric misses fail. Only explicitly listed substantive interpretive conflicts can receive need_review. Given experimental observations are not scored as predictions.

rules.expected: Explain the BN-versus-CC excitation change through actual electronic-structure evidence: BN substitution raises the frontier occupied level more than the frontier unoccupied level and reduces their separation, while state-character evidence makes the low-state comparison physically meaningful. Both source S1 states are predominantly HOMO-to-LUMO, but equivalent transition-density/NTO or many-electron evidence can establish the same explanation without a prescribed orbital representation. The score is for this physical explanation, not a second award for a lower S1 number. Distinguish orbital eigenvalue separation from an interacting vertical excitation; neither a smaller gap alone nor unresolved SI charge-transfer descriptors establish quantitatively stronger charge transfer. Bound robustness to the supported molecular states and model, without claiming device or emission-rate predictions. Explain the intensity redistribution as well as the energy shift: use actual transition character, transition-dipole evidence or an equivalent physical analysis to connect the weak lowest excitations and the distinct dominant bright transitions to the changed absorption pattern. A lower BN S1 does not itself predict a red shift of the dominant absorption band; distinguish the weak onset from the bright band. Do not earn explanation credit by repeating the separately scored energy/strength values or orderings. No fixed orbital decomposition or new descriptor is required.

historical_acceptance.scientific_limitations: BN/CC source six-state energies and oscillator strengths were actually computed; BN small energy residuals -0.0005 to -0.0002eV and S5f+0.0011 remain distinct from printed source values. Source HOMO+1 wording conflicts are not treated as physical occupied acceptor targets. No global method/spin proof or optical/device kinetics.

tolerance_policy.basis: Uniform±0.10eV frontier levels and±0.05eV selected vertical-state energies are provisional comparison windows below the0.6325eV source S1 shift and below the main state separations; bright f uses±0.02 absolute dimensionless units. These category windows are not residual-plus-epsilon or author confidence intervals. Directional energy/gap and intensity-pattern leaves remain independent; no exact tolerance is assigned to unresolved S11 descriptors.

coordinator_review.scope: Scientific rubric, source and historical verification evidence; not a new chemical validation, online Judge calibration, or promotion of historical acceptance.
